metadata.notes: Audit-and-replace of auto-seeded placeholder picks for all 21 Andhra Pradesh destinations. APTDC 'Haritha' state-tourism hotel network used as the authoritative government anchor across hill stations, pilgrim towns and remote sites; temple devasthanams (TTD Tirumala, Srisaila Devasthanam) and APFDC/Forest Department eco-camps supply the rest. Notable catches: 'Nagarjunakonda Island Resort' wrongly tagged to amaravati (Nagarjunakonda is ~150 km away at Nagarjuna Sagar), 'Nandi Hills Homestay' tagged to horsley-hills (Nandi Hills is in Karnataka), 'Pulicat Lagoon Houseboat Stay' (Pulicat has no houseboat operation), 'TTDC Pulicat Lake Resort' (TTDC = Tamil Nadu; the AP-side property is APTDC Pulicat Lake View Resort at Tada/Nellore), 'Hotel Mayura River Retreat' Srisailam (Mayura is a Karnataka KSTDC brand, not AP). Honest-scarcity heavy across remote pilgrim villages (ahobilam, lepakshi), day-trip cave/heritage sites (belum-caves, undavalli-caves) and the small temple town of srikalahasti as expected.
